correctness.rationale: The Fano incidence graph has 21 flags, each with four neighbors in the line graph. Bipartiteness and absence of four-cycles imply at most one cross-edge between each pair in a seed matching; hence the six reported geometries exhaust all triples. An independent exact census encoded each of the 2^21 initial subsets by a bit position. For every vertex and round it took the OR over its six neighbor-pair intersections in the preceding round, then retained previously active positions. Intersecting active sets over all vertices gives the completed seeds exactly; differencing successive completed sets identifies the first completion round. The independent enumeration matches every coefficient: [0,0,0,392,4326,18606,53088,115776,203364,293916,352716,352716,293930,203490,116280,54264,20349,5985,1330,210,21,1]. There are no successful seeds of size below 3. A separate enumeration of 1,330 triples gave counts 686,84,168,168,168,56 for overlap, zero cross-edges, one cross-edge, opposite-end two, same-end two, and three cross-edges. Only one-cross, opposite-end two, and three-cross succeed, all in exactly 6, 5, and 4 rounds respectively. This gives 392/1330=28/95. Exactly 2,090,760 configurations succeed and 168 first complete at round 6, with none later. Weighting each exact size-k count by p^k(1−p)^(21−k) gives the reliability law and at p=1/2 gives 261345/262144.
residual_risks: This is a complete finite proof, not an extrapolation to other flag graphs or an asynchronous-time statement. The packaged Python version note says 3.8+, but int.bit_count requires Python 3.10 or newer; this is a documentation issue, not a change to the claim.

value.rationale: The 21 flags of the smallest projective plane form a canonical finite host, and threshold two is the first nontrivial activation rule. The central-endpoint distinction shows why just counting two cross-edges cannot decide contagion. The complete reliability polynomial and the longest successful time give reusable exact benchmarks across every Bernoulli seed rate and for parallel core peeling, not just an arbitrary sample or one hand-picked initial seed.
residual_risks: No proof for other incidence orders is offered. Value is in the complete canonical example and its motif classification, not in a general cascade theorem.
